description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the RetrieveThing class, which appears to handle retrieval commands for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. The file includes tests for JSON serialization/deserialization, object immutability, equality, handling null inputs, and verifying behavior with various fields like selected fields and snapshot revision.

classes.name: RetrieveThingTest
classes.description: A set of JUnit-based unit tests for the RetrieveThing class, verifying JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, null handling, and field-specific behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveThing class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetBuilderWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that providing null as the ThingId to the builder throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetBuilderWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that providing null as DittoHeaders to the builder throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that an instance can be correctly created from valid JSON input.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpectedWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Ensures JSON serialization includes selected fields properly.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJsonWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Checks JSON deserialization with selected fields.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldsReturnsEmptyOptionalIfUnspecified
methods.description: Verifies that getSelectedFields returns empty if not specified.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getSelectedFields returns the correct selected fields.

methods.name: getSnapshotRevisionReturnsEmptyOptionalIfRevisionIsUnspecified
methods.description: Verifies that getSnapshotRevision returns empty when not set.

methods.name: getSnapshotRevisionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getSnapshotRevision returns the correct value when set.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWithSnapshotRevisionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Validates JSON serialization with snapshot revision included.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJsonWithSnapshotRevision
methods.description: Verifies that deserialization works correctly when JSON includes snapshot revision.
